cat_datafields: concatenate a list of DataFields dicts along batch dimension using torch.cat
stack_datafields: stack a list of DataFields dicts into a new dimension using torch.stack
select_datafields: select a single batch index from a DataFields dict by key
to_half_precision: convert all float32 tensors in a DataFields dict to float16 precision
repeat_batch_datafields: repeat the batch dimension of all tensors in a DataFields dict n times
